I'm calculating distances from the iron atom to nearby histidine, aspartate, glutamate, and tyrosine residues to identify likely coordinating ligands, checking HIS 198 NE2 as a match within bonding distance and now measuring HIS 256 NE2.

I confirm HIS 256 NE2 is close enough to coordinate, then work through Asp200's OD1 and OD2 atoms, finding OD1 within range but OD2 too far. I rule out several other distant residues (Asp116, Tyr186, His180, Ser267, Asn235, Ser196, Asn306) as being too far from the iron, narrowing the coordinating set to His198, His256, and Asp200, then continue checking for any additional residue within bonding distance.
